```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(readxl, tidyverse, fpp2,httr2,jsonlite,robots.txt)
```



```{r}
get_cfbd_data <- function(endpoint, query_params = list()) {
  base_url <- "https://api.collegefootballdata.com"
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("CFBD_API_KEY")
  
  if (api_key == "") {
    stop("CFBD_API_KEY environment variable is not set. Check your .Renviron.")
  }
  
  req <- request(paste0(base_url, endpoint)) %>%
    req_headers(
      "Authorization" = paste("Bearer", api_key),
      "Accept" = "application/json"
    ) %>%
    req_url_query(!!!query_params) %>%
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 2) # Automatically retries if rate-limited or dropped
  
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  
  # Parse JSON into a flat data frame automatically
  resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
target_years <- c(2024, 2025)

# 1. TEAMS DATA
# Pulls core team info, FBS lists, and venue details
teams_fbs <- get_cfbd_data("/teams/fbs", list(year = 2025))
all_teams <- get_cfbd_data("/teams")

# 2. ROSTER DATA (Iterated by year)
# Pulls historical player rosters
rosters_df <- map_dfr(target_years, ~ {
  message(sprintf("Pulling rosters for %d...", .x))
  
  tryCatch({
    get_cfbd_data("/roster", list(year = .x, classification = "fbs"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("Failed for year %d: %s", .x, e$message))
    NULL
  })
})

# 3. PLAYERS DATA 
# Covers player search, usage, season overviews, and transfer portal entries
transfer_portal <- map_dfr(target_years, ~ {
  get_cfbd_data("/player/portal", list(year = .x))
})

player_usage <- map_dfr(target_years, ~ {
  get_cfbd_data("/player/usage", list(year = .x))
})

# 4. RECRUITING DATA
# Covers individual high school/JUCO recruits and team ranking summaries
recruits_df <- map_dfr(target_years, ~ {
  message(sprintf("Pulling recruiting class for %d...", .x))
  get_cfbd_data("/recruiting/players", list(year = .x))
})

team_recruiting_rankings <- map_dfr(target_years, ~ {
  get_cfbd_data("/recruiting/teams", list(year = .x))
})

team_recruiting_groups <- get_cfbd_data("/recruiting/groups", list(startYear = 2020, endYear = 2025))

# 5. DRAFT DATA
# Covers historical NFL draft picks (Note: The CFBD schema tracks draft history over time)
draft_picks <- map_dfr(2023:2025, ~ {
  get_cfbd_data("/draft/picks", list(year = .x))
})
```
